PLAN "Bodyweight Strength Foundations (12 Weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build foundational strength with bodyweight exercises"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Fundamentals" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full Body A":
        warmup:
          jumping jacks 3m
        main straight_sets:
          push-up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          inverted row (doorway bar) 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bodyweight squat 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lying hamstring stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday training 45m "Full Body B":
        warmup:
          high knees 3m
        main straight_sets:
          incline push-up (feet on floor, hands elevated) 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          chin-up (doorway bar, assisted as needed) 3x3..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          reverse lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          side plank 3x20s/side rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          standing quad stretch 2m
    WEEK 2:
